messages:
elaine: FYI I repeatedly saw dashboard widget snapshots from Org-C appear in Org-D's dashboard for ~1-3s after a workspace switch. repro steps below.

elaine: repro: sign-in as user@D, open dashboard, switch to org C via topbar, immediately switch back to D, click refresh widgets. observed a brief flash of Org-C rows in multiple widgets.

elaine: grabbed gateway trace (trimmed):
```
gateway recv: id=zz9 req=/console/widgets prefetch=true x-org= D x-session=tok-... 
gateway cache.lookup key=console:widgets:tenant=<missing-org> -> miss
gateway route.match -> legacy-fallback (returned match_id=legacy-42) 
gateway downstream call /internal/widgets?shard=23 headers: X-Request-Org=D
widgets-service responded 200 payload rows[0].owner_org=C
gateway served client payload -> UI shows C rows for D
```

elaine: note that cache key lacked tenant id because matcher-surface computed key earlier and the fallback path didn't inject canonical org into the key.

rob: yikes. different than saved-search leak earlier but similar root cause (mismatch between cache key genesis and eventual owned payload). which PR changed the fallback path?

sam: Friday we merged prefetch-rewrite that moved cache key generation into the matcher to optimize dedupe across routes (PR #5990). that probably tightened timings but didn't account for fallback.

frida: can we reproduce deterministically? e2e flakiness tracking is annoying.

elaine: I can reproduce locally with a 200ms artificial delay in matcher and hammering rapid org toggles. adding snippet to repro harness.

sam: short-term mitigation suggestions: 1) always include explicit X-Canonical-Org header in cache key computation path (use incoming request header, not matcher-derived context) 2) scrub any X-Owner-Org or X-Org-Tag from downstream service responses before returning to client 3) add a guard in gateway: if payload.owner_org != request.org then block and return 500 + metric.

rob: agree. also add a sanitizing middleware in widgets-service to assert rows.owner_org matches request.org for extra defense-in-depth. we should be conservative for Dedicated customers.

frida: I'll spin up an antimerge for prefetch-rewrite to rollback on prod if needed. can we canary the cache-key fix first?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam: branch/widget-cachekey-stub -> staging at commit b7c3d9.

elaine: owners: sam (gateway cache key), frida (widgets-service scrub), rob (dashboard e2e + telemetry), I'll own incident writeup + customer comms.

audit-bot: security-note: cross-tenant preview detected. creating incident ticket: INC-2026. Marked P2.

rob: I'll add a dashboard tile: metric console.owner_mismatch.count and top offending services. also add alert when >0 on prod for 5m.

sam: pushed cache-key patch to staging. also added unit tests asserting cache key includes X-Canonical-Org and that fallback path cannot compute empty tenant key.

frida: pushed scrub middleware to widgets-service. it strips X-Owner-* headers and validates row.owner_orgs; if mismatch -> log + replace with empty set. (we'll tighten behavior after review).

elaine: running 2m local hammer, repro rate down from ~15% -> 0.5%. still saw 1 occurrence during a tight race with worker-local cache warm. looks like worker-local tenant cache also needs invalidation on org switch.

sam: ok add worker-local cache invalidation on session org-change event and include org in worker cache key. I'll open a follow-up PR.

rob: can we coordinate uptime impact? scrub middleware returns 500 on mismatch currently which may cause UX errors. prefer to return sanitized empty widgets + metric. revert to 500 only if we see high mismatch count during remediation window.

elaine: agreed. update scrub to return empty sanitized payload and emit owner_mismatch metric with sample payload id.

deploy-bot: staging deploy complete. canary tests in progress.

audit-bot: note: Compliance notified. If any customer-visible data left tenant boundary file an external notification? pending legal review.

frida: running e2e for 10m on staging with org toggle + widget refresh. will post results.

rob: telemetry shows ~8 mismatches in the last hour on staging before patches. current staging window shows 0 mismatches for 12m. good sign but still want the worker-cache fix before prod.

sam: opened PR for worker cache invalidation and will add integration tests simulating org-change events. target: tomorrow morning.

elaine: plan: 1) land worker cache fix + scrub + cache-key -> staging 2) run 30m stress e2e with org toggles 3) monitor console.owner_mismatch for zero events 4) promote to prod w/ 1-hour canary and rollback plan.

rob: also create a UX ticket for slight debounce on the topbar org-picker (reduce flicker) as a long-term engineering + UX mitigation.

elaine: thanks all. I'll draft the incident summary once prod is stable and include affected orgs list from telemetry.

sam: thx. ping thread when ready to promote.

frida: +1 on communications. will prepare rollback script for prod route-affinity flags.

elaine: closing loop here for now ":rocket:"
